response.plan: Cast Deep-Cavern Bat to see their hand and exile their best nonland card; keep Faerie Mastermind in hand for flash-speed value later (surprise blocker/threat), and deploy Preacher of the Schism once I hit 3 lands.

response.why: Nothing changes by committing Faerie Mastermind during my own upkeep versus holding it at flash for later — the scary outcome across all lines is them resolving Sheoldred, the Apocalypse (a house I have no answer to in hand right now), and that risk exists regardless of my action here. Holding priority keeps my mana and Mastermind flexible for a better window.
response.plan: Keep holding Faerie Mastermind at flash; if Sheoldred, the Apocalypse resolves I need to prioritize finding removal or racing since it punishes both my draws and their creature deaths — until then, attack with Preacher of the Schism (deathtouch discourages blocks) and keep developing.

response.why: Casting the second Preacher of the Schism gives me a double deathtouch wall that dominates combat regardless of what they do, while holding priority just risks my own Preacher getting stunned by their Floodpits Drowner before I even get to deploy it.
response.plan: Cast Preacher of the Schism to build a double deathtouch wall on board; hold Faerie Mastermind and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares for future turns, and attack with deathtouch Preacher when it's safe to do so.

response.why: Attacking with both is close to free value: Deep-Cavern Bat is unblockable here (no flyers on their side) for guaranteed damage+lifelink, and Preacher's deathtouch means the worst case is an even trade with their Preacher while I still have a second Preacher at home — holding either creature back only forfeits upside with no added safety.
response.plan: Attack with both Deep-Cavern Bat and the non-sick Preacher of the Schism; my second Preacher (summoning sick) stays home as a deathtouch blocker. Keep Faerie Mastermind and Kaito in hand for future turns.

response.why: Chump-blocking with the expendable Vampire Token is best: it prevents all damage, nets a point of life from its own lifelink, and lets me keep BOTH Preachers of the Schism (my best attackers/blockers) intact while their Preacher survives too — trading my Preacher for theirs is fine but gives up a card of equal value for no extra gain, and double-blocking wastes the token for nothing since a single Preacher block already kills their attacker via deathtouch.
response.plan: Block with Vampire Token to eat the deathtouch hit safely and keep both Preachers on board; next turn attack with my untapped threats and keep Faerie Mastermind/Kaito in hand for future value.

response.why: Holding priority in upkeep costs nothing and preserves all 4 mana for casting Kaito, Bane of Nightmares in my main phase — committing Faerie Mastermind or Floodpits Drowner now for no immediate need just risks being caught mana-light if they land Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and forecloses my strongest play this turn.
response.plan: Hold everything through upkeep/draw, then cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares in my main phase; attack with both Preachers of the Schism (deathtouch discourages blocks) since I'm well ahead on life, and keep Floodpits Drowner/Faerie Mastermind as flash answers for their Enduring Curiosity or a surprise blocker.

response.why: Holding priority through draw step costs nothing and keeps all 4 mana open for casting Kaito, Bane of Nightmares in my main phase — committing a flash creature now for no immediate need forecloses that play and is only worse if Sheoldred, the Apocalypse shows up while I'm already tapped out.
response.plan: Hold everything through draw, then cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares in my main phase; attack with both Preachers of the Schism since I'm well ahead on life, and keep Floodpits Drowner x2 / Faerie Mastermind as flash answers for Enduring Curiosity or a surprise blocker.

response.plan: Cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares this main phase, then attack with both Preachers of the Schism and Deep-Cavern Bat since I'm well ahead on life; use Kaito's 0 ability post-combat to surveil and draw off their life loss. Keep Floodpits Drowner x2 and Faerie Mastermind in hand for future flash value.

response.why: Kaito's -2 ability taps their Enduring Curiosity (4/3, their best blocker) and puts stun counters on it, clearing the way for my two deathtouch Preachers and flying Bat to attack largely unopposed this turn — much better than +1 (only pumps Kaito, who can't attack yet anyway) or 0 (its card-draw clause triggers off life already lost this turn, which is zero before combat, so using it now wastes the draw).
response.plan: Activate Kaito's -2 to tap down Enduring Curiosity, then attack with both Preachers of the Schism and Deep-Cavern Bat; save Kaito's 0 ability for after combat once they've lost life, to convert it into card draw. Keep Floodpits Drowner x2 and Faerie Mastermind for flash value.

response.why: Attacking with everything is clearly best: Deep-Cavern Bat is unblockable (no flyers on their side) for free damage+lifelink, and both Preachers have deathtouch so any chump block just kills their blocker for free while the Preacher survives — holding back any attacker only forfeits free value with zero added safety.
response.plan: Attack with both Preachers of the Schism and Deep-Cavern Bat; after combat activate Kaito's 0 ability to draw cards off the life they lost this turn. Keep Floodpits Drowner x2 and Faerie Mastermind in hand for future flash value.

response.why: I'm way ahead on life (19 vs 10), so taking a couple points of damage from their small attackers is trivial. Trading my Floodpits Drowner into a mutual kill with their attacking Drowner removes a body I'd rather keep — it can still block again later, or its activated ability could shuffle away a stunned creature. Preserving the creature is worth more than saving 2 life at this life total.
response.plan: Don't block; take the minor damage and keep the Floodpits Drowner on board as a future blocker/utility piece. Continue holding Cut Down, Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, and the other Floodpits Drowner for reactive plays, then attack again with Bat/Preachers on my turn.

response.why: This is my own upkeep with an empty stack and nothing to react to — there's no reason to commit Faerie Mastermind, Floodpits Drowner, or Cut Down blind before I even see my draw and reach main phase, where I can deploy with full information and better mana efficiency. Cut Down still has no worthwhile target (their real threats are illegal, and I'd rather save it). The Floodpits Drowner activated ability is irrelevant right now since nothing of theirs carries a stun counter. Passing to draw step costs nothing since I hold priority throughout my own turn until I choose to act in main phase.
response.plan: Pass through upkeep and draw step. In main phase, play land drop if drawn, then attack with both Preachers and Deep-Cavern Bat for value (deathtouch/unblockable triggers), and decide postcombat whether to develop Faerie Mastermind/Floodpits Drowner or hold mana up for opponent's turn based on what I draw and what removal/threats they still have (1 card in hand, tapped out mostly). Keep Cut Down for a legitimate small threat.

response.why: Drew a second Kaito, still nothing on the stack in my own draw step, so there's no reason to react now. Passing preserves full information (post-draw) and mana flexibility to develop and attack in main phase where I can sequence the land drop, combat, and any postcombat plays optimally. Cut Down still has no worthwhile target and premature flash creatures give up information/tempo for no benefit right now.
response.plan: Pass through draw step into main phase. Play a land, attack with both Preachers and Deep-Cavern Bat for value, then decide postcombat development (Faerie Mastermind, Floodpits Drowner, second Kaito) versus holding mana for opponent's turn based on the board after combat and their remaining 1 card in hand. Keep Cut Down for a legitimate small threat.

response.why: The land drop is always correct — free value with zero downside — so 'Play Swamp' leaves score highest, preserving maximum future mana for Kaito, Cut Down, and flash creatures. Casting Kaito precombat is also strong: with 6-7 lands available I can deploy a hexproof 3/4 body and still hold up Cut Down plus a Floodpits Drowner, and his -2 can tap a potential blocker before attacks. Faerie Mastermind/Floodpits Drowner are better held for flash/reactive value than played precombat with no immediate need. Cut Down still has no good target. The Drowner activated ability is irrelevant since nothing is stunned right now.
response.plan: Play the Swamp land drop, then cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares for board presence and to hold up mana. Move to combat and attack with both Preachers (deathtouch triggers regardless of blocks) and Deep-Cavern Bat (unblockable), plus Floodpits Drowner if profitable. Postcombat, use Kaito's 0 ability for surveil+draws since damage was dealt, and hold remaining mana with Cut Down and any leftover flash creatures for opponent's turn.

response.why: With Kaito now on the battlefield precombat, using his -2 to tap one of their untapped blockers (best target: the non-sick Preacher of the Schism) is a clean, free tempo play — it guarantees more damage connects this combat with zero downside, since it's before I've committed to attacks. The 0 ability (surveil+draw) is wasted precombat since no life has been lost yet this turn — using it postcombat after damage nets real card draws. Playing the land is still free value. Passing outright forgoes a strictly beneficial precombat tap-down. Cut Down still lacks a good target, and Floodpits Drowner's activated ability has nothing stunned to target yet.
response.plan: Play the land drop, activate Kaito's -2 on their best untapped blocker (a Preacher of the Schism) to clear the way, then attack with both my Preachers, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Floodpits Drowner for maximum value. After combat damage, use Kaito's 0 ability for surveil and card draws off life lost, then hold up remaining mana with Cut Down and flash creatures for opponent's turn.

response.why: Postcombat main, opponent dealt life loss this turn — using Kaito's 0 ability (surveil 2, draw a card since opponent lost life) is pure value with zero downside and should be done now while it's live. Playing the land drop (Swamp or Island) is also free value. Casting Faerie Mastermind/Floodpits Drowner/Deep-Cavern Bat now gives up flash flexibility for the opponent's turn without urgency. Cut Down/Go for the Throat still have no pressing target. The +1 emblem is useless without other ninjas.
response.plan: Use Kaito's 0 ability for surveil 2 and a card draw. Play the land drop. Then hold remaining mana with Cut Down, Go for the Throat, and flash creatures (Faerie Mastermind, Floodpits Drowner, Deep-Cavern Bat) for opponent's turn, discarding down to hand size at end of turn if needed by casting a cheap flash creature.

response.why: Postcombat main, empty stack, nothing to react to. Kaito's 0 ability already used for value this turn. response.plan: Pass, holding Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, both Floodpits Drowners, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Kaito for reactive plays on opponent's turn. If hand size becomes an issue at end of turn, flash in a cheap creature then. Continue pressuring with attacks next turn.

Committing Faerie Mastermind/Floodpits Drowner/Deep-Cavern Bat/Cut Down now still gives up flash flexibility for no urgent need since opponent is nearly tapped out with only 1 card. Playing the land keeps everything else available.
response.plan: Play the land drop (Swamp or Island). Then pass, holding Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, both Floodpits Drowners, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Kaito for reactive plays on opponent's turn.

response.why: Board is stable and opponent is nearly hellbent (1 card) with no untapped mana threat this turn. Holding all reactive cards (Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, both Floodpits Drowners, Deep-Cavern Bat) preserves maximum flexibility for opponent's turn since nothing they can do right now demands an answer. The land drop is pure free value with no downside, so pass/land-drop leaves score highest; committing any flash creature or removal now for no immediate need scores lower.
response.plan: Play the land drop if not already done, then pass holding Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, both Floodpits Drowners, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Kaito for reactive plays on opponent's turn; I'll commit a flash creature only if opponent attacks or taps out into a play worth ambushing/answering.

response.why: It's my upkeep with full untapped mana and opponent's hand still empty (zero risk of a trick). Activating my Floodpits Drowner's ability to shuffle itself and their stunned Preacher of the Schism into their owners' libraries is pure free value - it permanently removes their deathtouch threat without spending a card from hand (just an activated ability), since that Floodpits Drowner already got its ETB value. This is clearly better than passing or committing new cards from hand for no immediate need.
response.plan: Activate Floodpits Drowner's ability targeting their stunned Preacher of the Schism to permanently remove it. Then proceed to my main phase/combat, continuing to hold Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, and Deep-Cavern Bat for reactive value, and attack profitably with my Preachers/Bat as usual.

response.why: Still an empty stack on my own draw step with opponent's hand empty - no threat to answer and no benefit to committing cards from hand now. I have no land in hand this turn but full mana already; better to move into main phase and combat where I can attack profitably and decide holistically rather than spend flash creatures/removal prematurely.
response.plan: Pass through draw into main phase. Attack with my Preachers, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Kaito for value (deathtouch/lifelink triggers and unblockable damage), keeping Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, both Deep-Cavern Bats, and Floodpits Drowner in hand for reactive plays on their turn.

response.why: Kaito's -2 ability (tap target creature, add 2 stun counters) is the correct precombat play here: opponent's hand is empty (zero risk) and tapping down one of their Preacher of the Schism blockers before combat guarantees more unblocked damage and denies them a blocker option, with no downside since it also stuns it for their next untap. Kaito's 0 ability is better saved for postcombat once opponent has actually lost life this turn (right now it would surveil-and-draw zero cards), and the +1 emblem is useless with no other ninjas. Committing flash creatures/removal from hand now has no urgent need given the dominant board.
response.plan: Use Kaito's -2 to tap and stun one of their Preacher of the Schism blockers, then move to combat and attack with both my Preachers, Deep-Cavern Bat, and Enduring Curiosity for value/damage. Use Kaito's 0 ability postcombat (after opponent has lost life) for surveil+draw. Continue holding Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, both Deep-Cavern Bats, and Floodpits Drowner for reactive value on their turn.

response.why: Attacking with everything is clearly correct: both Preachers' triggers (Vampire token + card draw) fire on declaration regardless of blocks, deathtouch discourages profitable blocks, Deep-Cavern Bat is unblockable (no opposing flyers), and Enduring Curiosity trades fine or hits for 4 - opponent only has a 2/1 Floodpits Drowner and a summoning-sick Preacher able to block. This pushes opponent from 8 life down to 3-5 and nets me extra cards and life via lifelink tokens. Holding back any attacker only reduces damage/value for no real benefit since I have no blockers I need to protect against their weak remaining board.
response.plan: Attack with all four creatures (both Preachers, Deep-Cavern Bat, Enduring Curiosity). After combat, use Kaito's 0 ability if available for card draw, and continue holding Go for the Throat, Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, both Deep-Cavern Bats, and Floodpits Drowner in hand for reactive plays on their turn.
